dishes.name: Spicy Miso Ramen
dishes.description: Rich pork broth blended with white miso and house chili oil, topped with slow-braised pork belly and a jammy egg.
dishes.preparation: Broth simmered for 12 hours; pork belly braised in soy and mirin, then torched before serving.

pt.name: Lámen de Missô Apimentado
pt.description: Caldo encorpado de porco com missô branco e óleo de pimenta da casa, coberto com barriga de porco braseada e ovo de gema mole.
pt.preparation: Caldo cozido por 12 horas; barriga de porco braseada no shoyu e mirin e maçaricada antes de servir.

dishes.name: Dan Dan Noodles
dishes.description: Sichuan-style noodles in a numbing, spicy sesame sauce with crispy minced pork and crushed peanuts.
dishes.preparation: Pork stir-fried until crisp; noodles boiled and tossed with the sauce at the table.

pt.name: Macarrão Dan Dan
pt.description: Macarrão ao estilo de Sichuan em molho apimentado de gergelim que adormece a boca, com carne de porco moída crocante e amendoim triturado.
pt.preparation: Porco salteado até ficar crocante; macarrão cozido e misturado ao molho na mesa.

dishes.name: Mushroom Shoyu Ramen
dishes.description: A clear, savory shiitake and kombu broth seasoned with soy sauce, with roasted tofu and bamboo shoots.
dishes.preparation: Dashi steeped cold overnight, then gently warmed; tofu roasted until golden.

pt.name: Lámen Shoyu de Cogumelos
pt.description: Caldo claro e saboroso de shiitake e kombu temperado com shoyu, com tofu assado e broto de bambu.
pt.preparation: Dashi em infusão a frio durante a noite e aquecido com cuidado; tofu assado até dourar.

dishes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
dishes.description: Wok-fried rice with aged kimchi, gochujang and crispy pork belly, crowned with a fried egg.
dishes.preparation: Day-old rice fried at high heat in a wok with kimchi and gochujang.

pt.name: Arroz Frito com Kimchi
pt.description: Arroz salteado no wok com kimchi curtido, gochujang e barriga de porco crocante, coroado com ovo frito.
pt.preparation: Arroz do dia anterior frito em fogo alto no wok com kimchi e gochujang.

dishes.name: Green Curry with Tofu
dishes.description: Fragrant Thai green curry with coconut milk, tofu, Thai eggplant and basil, served with jasmine rice.
dishes.preparation: Curry paste fried in coconut cream before simmering with vegetables and tofu.

pt.name: Curry Verde com Tofu
pt.description: Curry verde tailandês perfumado com leite de coco, tofu, berinjela tailandesa e manjericão, servido com arroz jasmim.
ingredients: pasta de curry verde (sem pasta de camarão)
pt.preparation: Pasta de curry frita no creme de coco antes de cozinhar com os legumes e o tofu.

dishes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
dishes.description: Yogurt-marinated chicken charred in the tandoor and finished in a creamy, mildly spiced tomato sauce.
dishes.preparation: Chicken marinated for 24 hours, cooked in a tandoor oven, then simmered in the sauce.

pt.name: Frango Tikka Masala
pt.description: Frango marinado no iogurte, tostado no forno tandoor e finalizado em molho de tomate cremoso e levemente condimentado.
pt.preparation: Frango marinado por 24 horas, assado no forno tandoor e depois cozido no molho.

dishes.name: Chana Masala
dishes.description: Chickpeas slow-cooked in a tangy, spicy tomato and onion gravy, served with basmati rice.
dishes.preparation: Whole spices tempered in oil, then simmered with chickpeas for two hours.

pt.name: Chana Masala (Grão-de-Bico ao Curry)
pt.description: Grão-de-bico cozido lentamente em molho picante e levemente ácido de tomate e cebola, servido com arroz basmati.
pt.preparation: Especiarias inteiras douradas no óleo e cozidas com o grão-de-bico por duas horas.

dishes.name: Grilled Lamb Kofta
dishes.description: Spiced lamb skewers grilled over charcoal with tahini sauce, sumac onions and warm flatbread.
dishes.preparation: Hand-shaped skewers grilled over charcoal.

pt.name: Kafta de Cordeiro Grelhada
pt.description: Espetinhos de cordeiro temperado grelhados na brasa, com molho tahine, cebola com sumac e pão sírio quentinho.
pt.preparation: Espetos moldados à mão e grelhados na brasa.

dishes.name: Falafel Plate
dishes.description: Crispy herb falafel with hummus, tabbouleh, pickled turnips and pita.
dishes.preparation: Falafel made from soaked raw chickpeas and deep-fried to order.

pt.name: Prato de Falafel
pt.description: Falafel de ervas crocante com homus, tabule, nabo em conserva e pão pita.
pt.preparation: Falafel feito com grão-de-bico cru demolhado e frito na hora.

dishes.name: Beer-Battered Fish Tacos
dishes.description: Crispy beer-battered cod in corn tortillas with chipotle mayo and lime cabbage slaw.
dishes.preparation: Cod battered and deep-fried to order.

pt.name: Tacos de Peixe Empanado na Cerveja
pt.description: Bacalhau fresco empanado na cerveja e crocante, em tortilhas de milho com maionese de chipotle e salada de repolho com limão.
ingredients: massa de cerveja (farinha de trigo, cerveja)
pt.preparation: Bacalhau empanado e frito na hora.

dishes.name: Beef Birria Tacos
dishes.description: Beef braised with guajillo and ancho chilies, folded into crisped corn tortillas with a cup of consommé for dipping.
dishes.preparation: Beef braised for six hours; tortillas dipped in the braising fat and griddled.

pt.name: Tacos de Birria de Carne
pt.description: Carne braseada com pimentas guajillo e ancho, em tortilhas de milho tostadas, com uma tigela de consomê para molhar.
pt.preparation: Carne braseada por seis horas; tortilhas passadas na gordura do cozimento e tostadas na chapa.

dishes.name: Elote
dishes.description: Charred street corn brushed with mayonnaise, rolled in cotija cheese and dusted with chili and lime.
dishes.preparation: Corn grilled over open flame, then dressed to order.

pt.name: Elote (Milho Mexicano)
pt.description: Milho tostado na brasa, pincelado com maionese, passado no queijo cotija e polvilhado com pimenta e limão.
pt.preparation: Milho grelhado na chama e temperado na hora.

dishes.name: Margherita Pizza
dishes.description: Wood-fired pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil.
dishes.preparation: Dough fermented for 48 hours, baked for 90 seconds in a wood-fired oven.

pt.name: Pizza Margherita
pt.description: Pizza no forno a lenha com molho de tomate San Marzano, muçarela de búfala fresca e manjericão.
pt.preparation: Massa fermentada por 48 horas e assada por 90 segundos no forno a lenha.

dishes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
dishes.description: Spaghetti tossed with crispy guanciale, egg yolk, pecorino romano and plenty of black pepper.
dishes.preparation: Sauce emulsified off the heat with pasta water; no cream.

pt.name: Espaguete à Carbonara
pt.description: Espaguete com guanciale crocante, gema de ovo, pecorino romano e bastante pimenta-do-reino.
pt.preparation: Molho emulsionado fora do fogo com a água do macarrão; sem creme de leite.

dishes.name: Walnut Pesto Gnocchi
dishes.description: Pan-seared potato gnocchi with basil and walnut pesto and blistered cherry tomatoes.
dishes.preparation: Gnocchi made in house, boiled, then seared in olive oil.

pt.name: Nhoque ao Pesto de Nozes
pt.description: Nhoque de batata dourado na frigideira com pesto de manjericão e nozes e tomatinhos tostados.
ingredients: nhoque de batata (batata, farinha de trigo, ovo)
pt.preparation: Nhoque feito na casa, cozido e depois dourado no azeite.

dishes.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
dishes.description: Creamy arborio risotto with porcini and cremini mushrooms, finished with butter and hard cheese.
dishes.preparation: Rice toasted, deglazed with white wine and stirred with stock for 18 minutes.

pt.name: Risoto de Cogumelos Selvagens
pt.description: Risoto cremoso de arroz arbóreo com cogumelos porcini e paris, finalizado com manteiga e queijo duro.
pt.preparation: Arroz tostado, deglaçado com vinho branco e mexido com o caldo por 18 minutos.

dishes.name: Grilled Salmon with Lemon-Dill Butter
dishes.description: Salmon fillet grilled skin-side down, with lemon-dill butter, roasted potatoes and asparagus.
dishes.preparation: Grilled to medium; butter melted over the fish at the pass.

pt.name: Salmão Grelhado com Manteiga de Limão e Endro
pt.description: Filé de salmão grelhado com a pele para baixo, com manteiga de limão e endro, batatas assadas e aspargos.
pt.preparation: Grelhado ao ponto; a manteiga derrete sobre o peixe na hora de servir.

dishes.name: Garlic Chili Prawns
dishes.description: Prawns sizzled in garlic butter with chili flakes and parsley, served with sourdough to mop up the sauce.
dishes.preparation: Cooked in a cast-iron pan and served still sizzling.

pt.name: Camarões ao Alho e Pimenta
pt.description: Camarões chiando na manteiga de alho com pimenta calabresa e salsinha, servidos com pão de fermentação natural para o molho.
pt.preparation: Feitos na frigideira de ferro e servidos ainda chiando.

dishes.name: Green Papaya Salad
dishes.description: Shredded green papaya pounded with chili, lime, fish sauce, dried shrimp and peanuts.
dishes.preparation: Pounded to order in a clay mortar.

pt.name: Salada de Mamão Verde
pt.description: Mamão verde ralado e socado com pimenta, limão, molho de peixe, camarão seco e amendoim.
pt.preparation: Socada na hora em pilão de barro.

dishes.name: Salted Edamame
dishes.description: Steamed young soybeans in the pod, finished with flaky sea salt.
dishes.preparation: Steamed to order.

pt.name: Edamame com Flor de Sal
pt.description: Soja verde na vagem cozida no vapor e finalizada com flor de sal.
pt.preparation: Cozido no vapor na hora.

dishes.name: Pork Gyoza
dishes.description: Pan-fried dumplings filled with pork, cabbage and ginger, with a soy and rice vinegar dipping sauce.
dishes.preparation: Folded by hand; pan-fried then steamed for a crisp base.

pt.name: Guioza de Porco
pt.description: Pastéis japoneses selados na frigideira, recheados com porco, acelga e gengibre, com molho de shoyu e vinagre de arroz.
pt.preparation: Fechados à mão; selados na frigideira e depois cozidos no vapor para a base ficar crocante.

dishes.name: Caesar Salad
dishes.description: Crisp romaine with anchovy-garlic dressing, sourdough croutons and shaved parmesan.
ingredients: caesar dressing (egg yolk, anchovy, dijon mustard)
dishes.preparation: Dressing emulsified in house daily.

pt.name: Salada Caesar
pt.description: Alface-romana crocante com molho de anchova e alho, croutons de fermentação natural e lascas de parmesão.
pt.preparation: Molho emulsionado na casa todos os dias.

dishes.name: Tiramisu
dishes.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa.
dishes.preparation: Assembled the day before and chilled overnight.

pt.name: Tiramisù
pt.description: Biscoitos champanhe embebidos em espresso, em camadas com creme de mascarpone e polvilhados com cacau.
pt.preparation: Montado no dia anterior e gelado durante a noite.

dishes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
dishes.description: Sweet glutinous rice soaked in salted coconut cream, served with ripe mango and toasted sesame.
dishes.preparation: Rice steamed, then soaked in warm sweetened coconut milk.

pt.name: Arroz Doce Tailandês com Manga
pt.description: Arroz glutinoso adocicado no creme de coco com uma pitada de sal, servido com manga madura e gergelim tostado.
pt.preparation: Arroz cozido no vapor e depois embebido em leite de coco morno adoçado.

dishes.name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
dishes.description: Dense, fudgy dark chocolate cake made with almond flour, served with whipped cream.
dishes.preparation: Baked in a water bath and rested for a dense texture.

pt.name: Bolo de Chocolate sem Farinha de Trigo
pt.description: Bolo denso e úmido de chocolate amargo feito com farinha de amêndoas, servido com chantilly.
pt.preparation: Assado em banho-maria e descansado para ficar com textura densa.
